approval: Owner, 2026-11-20 goal: all factions, autonomous (no per-faction card review).
tradeAxis: Cleave (role striker: shaped basic attacks, whirlwinds and area shots that pay off against many small or bunched stacks) versus Lance (role ward: Double Strike, Defence-ignoring blows, dives and 2-hex thrusts that pay off against one big stack). Both are useful in any army; the choice only gets sharper when the player decides how the enemy deploys.
